# Security Policy

**PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY, [SEE BELOW](#reporting-a-vulnerability).**

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within EET 2.0 Module, please send an email to GuNNeR42 at 98356310+GuNNeR42@users.noreply.github.com. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
